name: Art Blocks Studio | 56
description: Art Blocks Engine core: an ERC-721 contract for the on-chain generative art collection Art Blocks Studio | 56.
about:
## About

This is an Art Blocks Engine V3 core contract (`GenArt721CoreV3_Engine`, coreVersion `v3.2.4`) for the collection **Art Blocks Studio | 56** (symbol `ABSTUDIO_56`). It is an ERC-721 collection whose artworks are generated from scripts stored on-chain; each token carries a unique hash that seeds its deterministic, generative output.

## Proxy pattern

This address is an **EIP-1167 minimal proxy (clone)**. It holds this collection's own storage but delegates all logic to a shared implementation contract at `0x00000000559ca3f3f1279c0ec121c302ed010457`, which many Art Blocks Engine cores clone. The verified source shown for this address is that of the implementation.

## Surrounding platform contracts

This core does not sell tokens itself. Minting, randomness, administration, and royalties run through separate Art Blocks platform contracts that the core points at:

- **MinterFilterV2** (`0xa2ccfe293bc2cdd78d8166a82d1e18cd2148122b`) — routes purchases; the only address allowed to call `mint_Ecf`. The active minter for this collection is a fixed-price minter, `MinterSetPriceV5` (`0x0635e2f2926b306356b5b3f5cb6489107796b085`).
- **SharedRandomizerV0** (`0x13178a7a8a1a9460dbe39f7eccebd91b31752b91`) — assigns each token's hash seed after mint; the only address allowed to call `setTokenHash_8PT`.
- **AdminACLV0** (`0xdb35874a04d3135fb4839b8b042c04b9f7686032`) — the super-admin gate; it is also this core's `owner`/`admin` and controls every admin action.
- **CoreRegistryV1** (`0x2ee7b9bb2e038be7323a119701a191c030a61ec6`), **SplitProviderV0** (`0x000000000ef75c77f6bd0b2ee166501fbbdb40c8`, wraps 0xSplits for royalties), and **UniversalBytecodeStorageReader** (`0x000000000000a791abed33872c44a3d215a3743b`, reads on-chain script storage).

## Royalties

The contract implements ERC-2981 (`royaltyInfo`), with secondary-sale splits handled through the split provider.
risks: EIP-1167 clone — all logic is delegated to the shared implementation at 0x0000...0457
The AdminACL super-admin can swap the minter, randomizer, split provider, bytecode reader, and provider payout addresses at any time
Before a project is locked, its artist or authorized AdminACL callers can rewrite its scripts and name
Locking does not freeze every setting: the artist can still change its base URI and lower max invocations
Minting is gated entirely through the external MinterFilter; the core does not sell tokens directly
Token hash seeds that drive generative output are assigned post-mint by the external randomizer contract

projectDetails.title: Project Details
projectDetails.description: Returns a project's name, artist name, description, website, and license.

projectScriptDetails.title: Project Script Details
projectScriptDetails.description: Returns a project's script type, version, aspect ratio, and number of stored script chunks.

projectStateData.title: Project State
projectStateData.description: Returns invocation counts, active and paused flags, completion time, and locked state.

completedTimestamp.label: completed at
completedTimestamp.description: Zero until completion; otherwise the Unix timestamp when the project completed.

projectScriptByIndex.title: Project Script Chunk
projectScriptByIndex.description: Returns one stored chunk of a project's on-chain generative script by index.

tokenIdToHash.title: Token Hash
tokenIdToHash.description: Returns the unique hash that seeds a token's deterministic generative output.

tokenIdToProjectId.title: Token's Project
tokenIdToProjectId.description: Returns the ID of the project a given token belongs to.

royaltyInfo.title: Royalty Info
royaltyInfo.description: ERC-2981: returns the royalty recipient and amount owed for a token at a given sale price.

mint_Ecf.title: Mint
mint_Ecf.description: Mints the next token of a project to a recipient. Callable only by the configured minter contract.
mint_Ecf.warning: Only the core's minter contract (the MinterFilter) can call this; collectors mint through the active minter, not here.

minterContract.title: Minter Contract
minterContract.description: The address (an Art Blocks MinterFilter) authorized to mint tokens for this core.

isMintWhitelisted.title: Is Minter Allowed
isMintWhitelisted.description: Check whether an address is authorized as this core's minter.

addProjectScript.title: Add Script Chunk
addProjectScript.description: Appends a chunk to a project's on-chain script. Artist or admin, only while the project is unlocked.

updateProjectScript.title: Update Script Chunk
updateProjectScript.description: Replaces one chunk of a project's script. Artist or admin, only while the project is unlocked.

updateProjectMaxInvocations.title: Set Max Invocations
updateProjectMaxInvocations.description: Lowers a project's maximum number of mintable tokens. Callable by the project's artist.
updateProjectMaxInvocations.warning: Max invocations can only be decreased and never set below the number already minted.

toggleProjectIsPaused.title: Toggle Paused
toggleProjectIsPaused.description: Pauses or unpauses purchasing for a project. Callable by the project's artist.

updateProjectBaseURI.title: Set Project Base URI
updateProjectBaseURI.description: Sets the base URI used to build token metadata URLs for a project. Callable by the artist.

updateProjectSecondaryMarketRoyaltyPerce.title: Set Secondary Royalty
updateProjectSecondaryMarketRoyaltyPerce.description: Sets a project's artist secondary-market royalty percentage. Callable by the project's artist.

proposeArtistPaymentAddressesAndSplits.title: Update Artist and Payment Splits
proposeArtistPaymentAddressesAndSplits.description: Updates the controlling artist address and payment splits; this clone applies every change immediately.
proposeArtistPaymentAddressesAndSplits.warning: Changing the artist address immediately transfers every artist-only permission to the new address and removes the caller's artist access.

addProject.title: Add Project
addProject.description: Creates a new project with a name and artist address. Callable only through the AdminACL.

toggleProjectIsActive.title: Toggle Active
toggleProjectIsActive.description: Activates or deactivates a project. The project artist or an authorized AdminACL caller can use this clone.

adminAcceptArtistAddressesAndSplits.title: Accept Payment Splits
adminAcceptArtistAddressesAndSplits.description: Unavailable on this clone because artist payment changes are automatically accepted.
adminAcceptArtistAddressesAndSplits.warning: This clone never retains a pending proposal for the AdminACL to accept, so this call reverts.

updateMinterContract.title: Set Minter Contract
updateMinterContract.description: Changes the minter (MinterFilter) authorized to mint for this core. Callable only through the AdminACL.
updateMinterContract.warning: The new minter gains full control over which tokens are minted and to whom.

updateRandomizerAddress.title: Set Randomizer
updateRandomizerAddress.description: Changes the randomizer that assigns token hash seeds. Callable only through the AdminACL.

forbidNewProjects.title: Forbid New Projects
forbidNewProjects.description: Permanently blocks creation of any further projects on this core. Callable through the AdminACL.
forbidNewProjects.warning: This is irreversible — no new projects can ever be added afterward.

setTokenHash_8PT.title: Set Token Hash
setTokenHash_8PT.description: Assigns a token's generative hash seed. Callable only by the configured randomizer contract.
setTokenHash_8PT.warning: Only the randomizer contract can call this; a token's hash can be set only once.

coreType.title: Core Type
coreType.description: The Art Blocks core contract type identifier for this contract.

coreVersion.title: Core Version
coreVersion.description: The Art Blocks core contract version string.

randomizerContract.title: Randomizer
randomizerContract.description: The randomizer contract that assigns token hash seeds for this core.

adminACLContract.title: Admin ACL
adminACLContract.description: The AdminACL contract whose super-admin controls this core's admin actions.

splitProvider.title: Split Provider
splitProvider.description: The provider that creates royalty splitter contracts for secondary sales.

nextProjectId.title: Next Project ID
nextProjectId.description: The ID that will be assigned to the next project added to this core.

Mint.title: Mint
Mint.description: Emitted when a token is minted to an address.

ProjectUpdated.title: Project Updated
ProjectUpdated.description: Emitted when a project's data or state changes, tagged with the type of update.

PlatformUpdated.title: Platform Updated
PlatformUpdated.description: Emitted when a core-level configuration value changes, tagged with the field.

MinterUpdated.title: Minter Updated
MinterUpdated.description: Emitted when the core's minter contract is changed.

ProposedArtistAddressesAndSplits.title: Proposed Payment Splits
ProposedArtistAddressesAndSplits.description: Emitted when an artist proposes new payout addresses and splits for a project.

AcceptedArtistAddressesAndSplits.title: Accepted Payment Splits
AcceptedArtistAddressesAndSplits.description: Emitted when an artist's proposed payout addresses and splits are accepted.

GenArt721Error.title: Core Error
GenArt721Error.description: Enum-coded revert covering ~38 reasons: owner/artist/ACL/minter/randomizer gating, invocation limits, and validation.
